dogecoin.text:
8/
Yes, it faded into obscurity.
Yes, most of the wallets are probably gone.
But if you’re looking for the origin of memecoins,
this is it.

BBQcoin is the missing link between Bitcoin and Dogecoin.

6/
🔥 This wasn’t some copycat Dogecoin clone.
🔥 This was over a YEAR before Doge.
🔥 This was possibly the first time humor was embedded into code.

A true cultural artifact in crypto history.
